items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team will monitor how he feels this week before determining Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Left early Week 1 with chest/rib after big hit; imaging and monitoring.
items.implication: Risk of missing or limited Week 2; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for other LAC WRs if out.

items.text: Weekend reports: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Rome Odunze (calf) EXPECTED TO PLAY; Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED; Malik Nabers (knee) NO NEWS YET (later active).
items.implication: Love/Odunze startable; Kamara absence opens NO backfield; Nabers GTD resolved active.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: As expected for good offense; elite concentration.
items.implication: Lock in the four; fade depth pieces.
items.opportunity: High floor/ceiling for the core four via snaps/targets/carries.

items.text: Bucky Irving W1: 8 carries (rush TD), 21 routes/7 targets (all caught) for 22.3 PPR (overstated vs usage). Only RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13; looked healthy. Great CLE matchup next.
items.implication: Sustainable RB2/flex with TD upside; prefer over Gainwell.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but two almost-plays; 92% route participation. Buying low everywhere possible; want all the Loveland.
items.why: Elite route rate despite low production; preseason favorite.
items.implication: Buy-low TE1 upside in Bears offense.
items.conflict: Concern listed in recap but overall love.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after meniscus trim; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus procedure last week; progressing well.
items.implication: Potential Week 2 return boosts TE value; Mayer filled in W1.
items.opportunity: If out again, Mayer continues elevated role.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne did not dominate more with Kamara (knee) out: snaps Etienne 53/Miller 26/Donaldson 15; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne not full dominate; committee risk ROS if Kamara returns or split continues.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: High route/target share on limited snaps; healthy.
items.implication: Ramp-up complete enough for WR2/3; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Target share alpha if volume rises.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring not serious (DTD); would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending but coach confirms DTD, good sign after leaving early Week 1.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated, left early but not considered serious.
items.implication: Likely available Week 2 or close; low long-term concern.

items.text: Risk/reward decoy possible but starting Malik Nabers everywhere after active; post-injury return.
items.implication: Must-start in flex/WR despite rust risk.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere—wouldn't activate if injury worry (Cardinals caveat).
items.implication: RB2 start with upside in ARI backfield.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks W1; even with Dylan Sampson (knee) out early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Limited receiving upside; more pure runner.

items.text: Week 1 recap concerns: Loveland/LAC offense/Fannin/London-Pitts/Etienne. Time now for Watson/Monty/Coke Heads; Likely breakout.
items.why: Box scores vs underlying (routes for Loveland); committee/role questions.
items.implication: Buy low Loveland/Monty; caution Etienne/London-Pitts; stream Likely.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.why: Strong W1 production signaling expanded role.
